claim: The 2026 Chicago Blues Festival runs June 4-7, opening June 4 at Bridgeport's Ramova Theatre then three days June 5-7 at Millennium Park, free admission.
quote: City of Chicago Announces Lineup for 2026 Chicago Blues Festival, June 4-7

claim: The Chicago Blues Festival is the world's largest free blues festival, running since 1984, with Millennium Park hours noon to 9 p.m. daily across stages including the Jay Pritzker Pavilion, Mississippi Crossroads Stage and Rosa's Lounge Stage.
quote: the Chicago Blues Festival is the world's largest free blues festival ... festival hours are noon to 9 p.m. daily across multiple stages, including the Jay Pritzker Pavilion, Mississippi Crossroads Stage, Rosa's Lounge Stage and Wrigley Square

claim: The 55th annual Chicago Pride Parade is free and held Sunday, June 28, 2026, stepping off at 11 a.m. in the Northalsted neighborhood with nearly one million spectators.
quote: The free Chicago Pride Parade will be held on Sunday, June 28. The parade steps off at 11 a.m. in the landmark LGBTQ+ Northalsted neighborhood, bringing together nearly one million spectators and over 15,000 participants.

claim: The 25th annual Chicago Pride Fest, a two-day street festival, runs June 20-21, 2026 on Halsted Street with live music on three stages headlined by Durand Bernarr, G Flip, Willa Ford and MNEK.
quote: The 25th annual two-day street festival will be held June 20-21 on Halsted Street from Addison Street to Grace Street, featuring live music on three stages with headliners including Durand Bernarr, G Flip, Willa Ford and MNEK

claim: Andersonville's 60th annual Midsommarfest runs June 12-14, 2026, and Navy Pier Pride is a free day of festivities on June 27, 2026.
quote: The 60th annual Midsommarfest in Andersonville will be from June 12 - 14 ... Navy Pier Pride is a full day of free festivities in honor of the LGBTQ+ community at the city's iconic lakefront attraction on June 27, 2026

claim: The free Millennium Park Summer Music Series runs select Mondays and Thursdays June 15-August 6, 2026 at the Pritzker Pavilion, shows at 6:30 p.m., with all seating in the bowl and Great Lawn free and first come, first served.
quote: runs on select Mondays and Thursdays from June 15 - August 6, 2026, with shows beginning at 6:30 p.m. and free admission ... All seats within the Pavilion's seating bowl and space on the Great Lawn are free and first come, first served

claim: The 2026 Millennium Park Summer Music Series is headlined by Sheila E. (June 22) and Arrested Development (June 15 opener), plus Patrice Rushen and Marcos Valle.
quote: Sheila E. and Arrested Development, local band La Rosa Noir to headline Millennium Park 2026 Summer Music Series

claim: The free Grant Park Music Festival's 92nd season runs June 10-August 15, 2026 on Wednesday and Friday evenings at the Jay Pritzker Pavilion, opening June 10 with Bernstein's West Side Story.
quote: begins on Wednesday June 10 with an orchestral presentation of Bernstein's West Side Story ... Wednesday and Friday evenings from June 10 - August 15 at the Jay Pritzker Pavilion

claim: The Grant Park Music Festival is one of the only free outdoor classical-music concert series in the US; the back half of the Seating Bowl is free and the Great Lawn welcomes blankets.
quote: one of the only free outdoor classical-music concert series in the US ... grab a free seat in the back half of the Seating Bowl at the Jay Pritzker Pavilion or bring a blanket and enjoy a space on the Great Lawn

claim: Buddy Guy's Legends, opened 1989 and still owned by Buddy Guy, has live blues every night plus free acoustic lunch and dinner sessions, with Buddy himself performing a month of shows each January.
quote: opened in 1989 by blues musician Buddy Guy who still owns the club and makes regular appearances, performing a month of shows each January ... live blues every night of the week, plus free acoustic sessions over the lunch and dinner hours

claim: The Green Mill in Uptown opened in 1907, was an Al Capone-era speakeasy, has live jazz seven nights a week with bands from 8pm-midnight, is cash only, and hosts the Uptown Poetry Slam (birthplace of the slam movement) the third Sunday monthly for a $5 cover.
quote: live music seven nights a week ... Bands play from 8pm - midnight ... The Slam currently takes place the third Sunday of each month ... a mere five-dollar cover charge ... The Green Mill takes CASH ONLY

claim: Second City's Chicago resident stages (Mainstage, e.t.c., UP Comedy Club) run headline sketch and improv shows including the Wheel of Improv and Ten Dollar Comedy, a weekly $10 stand-up and improv showcase.
quote: Ten Dollar Comedy, a weekly showcase featuring some of Chicago's best stand-up and improv comedy - all for only $10

claim: iO Theater offers live improv comedy with house teams and special guests six nights a week, plus classes and event spaces.
quote: Chicago's comedy destination with live improv shows six nights a week, classes for all levels, and event spaces
